ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface with a low ratio of high-intensity pixels (estimated 5-8%) concentrated in localized circular and linear anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-intensity yellow-white circular blobs (approx. 10-15 units) distributed across both lobes. A single high-intensity vertical linear mark is positioned near the lower central axis of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees, showing a clean separation between the inner lobe margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge. The right distal tip exhibits extreme irregular topography with high-amplitude jagged peaks due to biological colonization.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward sweep starting from the median notch and terminating in acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular yellow-hued clusters (barnacles) localized primarily in the mid-region of the left lobe and scattered across the medial region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, high-contrast vertical white linear mark near the lower trailing edge of the left lobe. Faint, horizontal low-contrast linear disruptions are visible on the upper section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive stalked barnacle colonization on the right distal tip, creating a significant deviation from a smooth geometric contour. Minor colonization visible on the left distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The right distal tip features a dense cluster of dark, cylindrical appendages (stalked barnacles) extending beyond the fluke's primary trailing edge boundary.
